name: Chessmasters
oneLineDescription: Chessmasters is an AI chess game analyzer that turns Chess.com and Lichess games into plain-English coaching reports.
category: AI chess game analysis and coaching
audience: Chess players rated roughly 800-1800 Elo on Chess.com or Lichess
features: Coaching report for any finished public Chess.com or Lichess game
Stockfish centipawn-loss and blunder detection behind every claim
Key moments on interactive boards with evaluation and accuracy charts
Focus areas linked to Lichess training material
AI Psychological Profile (Tilt Resistance, Composure, Playing Style) after three games
Batch analysis of up to five games per submission

pricing.free: 5 analyses total; first analysis without an account
pricing.pro: INR 399 per month for 100 analyses per billing period

founders.name: Parth Kaushik
founders.role: Co-Founder & Chess Pedagogy (FIDE Arena International Master, AIM)

affiliation: Independent; not affiliated with Chess.com or Lichess
